scientific_integrity: The general face-algebra identification, small fork example, Gabriel theorem and extended-Dynkin tame characterization are credited as prior results; only the explicit sharp input-level classification, affine-factor census, and finite-type indecomposable-count equality are assessed.
scientific_limitations: Finite acyclic quivers and algebraically closed base fields only; external path-algebra and Dynkin-classification theorems are prerequisites; finite spectral tests are corroboration rather than an infinite proof; publication priority is not independently certified.
title: Finite–tame–wild trichotomy and affine-factor census for acyclic face algebras
